purpose: Teach: 属する/従う/密接/超過/所在/着手/急増/取り上げる

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、本気で、絶対、業界に、絶対、属する、絶対、企業として、絶対、責任を、絶対、果たせ、本気で、頼んだぞ
lines.en: I'm asking you seriously and absolutely: this company must fulfill its responsibility as an industry leader.
lines.style: Direct and measured. Clipped consonants on key demands. Authoritative without shouting. Holds the weight of each phrase. A superior laying down expectations, not negotiating.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。法令に、本気で、絶対、従う、絶対、徹底しております、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Yes. We are thoroughly committed to following all applicable laws with absolute seriousness.
lines.style: Formal and precise. Even cadence. Each clause lands with quiet confidence. The tone of someone reporting back what was heard and understood, word for word.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: お得意様と、本気で、絶対、密接、絶対、な、絶対、関係、絶対、保て、本気で、頼んだぞ
lines.en: And I need you to maintain close, strong relationships with our valued clients.
lines.style: Firm pivot. Slightly warmer than the first demand but no less serious. Emphasis on 'close'—this is strategic, not optional. Authority with expectation of understanding.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。予算、本気で、絶対、超過、絶対、しないよう、絶対、徹底しております、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Understood. We will ensure our budgets remain strictly within limits without exception.
lines.style: Steady and assured. Almost rhythmic in delivery. The reassurance of someone confirming they've absorbed the instruction and will execute flawlessly.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 責任の、本気で、絶対、所在、絶対、明確に、絶対、しろ、本気で、頼んだぞ
lines.en: Make it absolutely clear where responsibility lies. I need clarity and accountability.
lines.style: Harder edge. Sharp attack on 'clear.' Lean forward slightly in the delivery. Non-negotiable. This is about structure, not opinion.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。新規プロジェクト、本気で、絶対、着手、絶対、いたします、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Yes. We will begin new projects immediately with the full focus they deserve.
lines.style: Crisp confirmation. Professional and ready. The tone of someone signaling 'understood, moving forward'—no hesitation, no need for further discussion.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: お客様の、本気で、絶対、急増、絶対、対応、絶対、進めろ、本気で、頼んだぞ
lines.en: Address the surge in customer demand. Move forward with that priority now.
lines.style: Sharp urgency. Quick pace. Cut through to the essential action. The tone of a superior turning attention to the next critical challenge—not hostile, but decisive.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。社員の、本気で、絶対、意見を、絶対、取り上げる、絶対、姿勢、絶対、続けてまいります、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Yes. We will continue to value and elevate our staff's voices and perspectives.
lines.style: Warm close after intensity. Slower pace. Genuine commitment underneath the formality. The tone of someone affirming a principle they stand behind, not just parroting instructions.
